share.title: LAN sharing
share.comingSoon: Coming soon: share your library to devices on the LAN, read-only.
share.scopeHint: Sharing is off by default. When on, each target (library / series / tag / item set) gets its own switch and access token.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your experience
settings.saveHintGeneral: Theme & toggles apply instantly; other changes apply after saving
settings.saveHintOther: Changes apply after saving, across the whole settings page
engine.heading: Playback engine
engine.placeholderTitle: This section will be filled in M5 (transcode diagnostics + managed install)
engine.placeholderHint: Every video is transcoded by the local ffmpeg today, but this build has no install-state probe, path override or hardware-acceleration control -- so no controls are shown here on purpose: a row of dead switches would be worse than an honest blank.
downloads.heading: Download settings
downloads.dirNote: Leave empty to download into the library's "downloads" subfolder (system default folder when no library root is set); pick from history.
downloads.libDirNote: Managed library root: both Telegram archiving and the default manual download folder ("downloads" subdir) live here; changes apply to new downloads only.
downloads.classifyHint: Archive by category folder; extensions separated by comma, semicolon or space
downloads.addCatHint: Separate multiple extensions with comma/semicolon/space, e.g. mp4, mkv; avi; rmvb. When one extension belongs to multiple categories, the last saved wins.
network.heading: Multi-NIC splitting
network.nicsHint: Primary NIC always participates; select more connected NICs to accelerate in parallel
network.weightHint: Weights auto-allocated as (NIC count + 1) shares: primary gets 2, others 1 each (e.g. 3 NICs → 50% / 25% / 25%). The picker only selects participating NICs; changes apply globally after saving and apply to new downloads.
network.daemonOff: Daemon not connected, cannot enumerate NICs
proxy.heading: Proxy settings
proxy.modeHint: Direct by default; system proxy follows env vars (Windows system settings must be entered manually as custom)
proxy.savedApplied: Saved; new downloads will use this proxy
proxy.note: BT/DHT proxy supported in a later version; proxy currently applies only to HTTP(S) downloads (same path for probing and chunk requests).
general.heading: General settings
general.autoStartHint: Auto-start this app on system login
general.notifyHint: Send a system notification when a task completes
about.heading: About
about.logsHint: Read logs by the path below when something fails. Only startup and failure events are written - never per-request traces - so downloads and playback are unaffected.
about.logsUnavailable: Engine not ready; no log path yet
about.logsOrigTg: Full orig-tg subprocess output (start-up failures land here)
about.logsErrors: Core engine errors (every failed start, appended by time)
ctx.activeHint: Active tasks in the download queue (TG cache tasks not included)
ctx.speedHint: Aggregate speed of all active tasks
accounts.heading: Account binding
accounts.sub: Manage bound external accounts; binding unlocks the related feature
accounts.tgNotBound: Not bound — log in to access Telegram channels
accounts.nationalOnly: Enter local number only; area code selected on the left
accounts.passwordHint: Two-step verification enabled; enter password to continue
accounts.note: Account data is stored locally only. Telegram uses a standalone orig-tg service that must be launched by Tauri.
accounts.diagDesc: Inspect orig-tg service status and logs to troubleshoot login/code failures
accounts.tgUnavailableHint: orig-tg could not reach Telegram, so sending codes and signing in will fail. See Connection diagnostics below for the reason.
accounts.tgUnreachableHint: orig-tg is not running, so the sign-in state cannot be confirmed. Start the service and retry.
accounts.diagFail: Cannot reach diagnostics API; make sure orig-tg is running
tg.toggleHint: When enabled, daemon launches orig-tg with the main proxy injected; disabling stops it and hides the TG module
tg.alreadyIngested: Already in the library, no need to download again
tg.startFailedHint: The TG service failed to start; the module is hidden. Reason: {reason}
tg.serviceDownHint: The daemon is the sole owner of the TG service and will restart it automatically. If it stays down, toggle the Telegram plugin off and on again under General.
tg.needsConfigHint: Open Settings - Accounts and fill in api_id and api_hash (create an app at my.telegram.org). The service restarts itself after saving - no manual step.
tg.linkDownHint: Credentials are set but Telegram is unreachable (usually network or proxy). The daemon retries on its own; see Connection diagnostics under Settings - Accounts for the reason.
tg.heading: Telegram Channels
tg.selectChannel: Select a channel on the left to view media
tg.locateFailed: Could not locate the matching source message in the TG panel (it may have been deleted or is out of reachable range)
tg.locateNoChannel: The source channel of this content is not in the TG subscriptions, so it cannot be located
tg.cacheManagerHint: Track how subscribed content is being ingested into the library (independent of the selected channel)
tg.cacheBatchRetryHint: Only the {hit} retryable item(s) will be retried; the other {miss} won't be affected
tg.cacheBatchCancelHint: Only the {hit} active item(s) will be cancelled; the other {miss} won't be affected
tg.cacheDeleteConfirmRunning: Running tasks among them will be stopped. Only records are deleted; cached bytes are kept.
tg.cachePreferDownloadHint: Download first = it runs next after the current task finishes; the running task is never interrupted
tg.cacheCancelPreferHint: Cancel priority: go back to the default first-in-first-out order
tg.cacheBatchPreferDownloadHint: Only the {hit} prioritizable item(s) will be prioritized; the other {miss} won't be affected
tg.cacheNoTasks: No ingest records in this group
tg.cacheTaskHint: Cached items show their ingest progress here
tg.manifestToggleHint: Expand to see per-item ingest status
tg.notMonitored: This channel is not monitored yet; add it to auto-archive new content
tg.protectedMedia: Protected or access denied; cannot cache. Try online playback.
tg.cacheFailed: Caching failed. Retry, or play it online instead.
tg.noStored: No stored media yet; click “Sync now” to pull new content
tg.clearCacheHint: Delete cached media files in the download folder; library entries are kept and can be re-cached
tg.clearCacheConfirm: Clear cache? All cached media files in the download folder will be deleted (library entries are kept and can be re-cached).
tg.clearCacheFileHint: Delete cached media files in the download folder; library entries are kept and can be re-cached
tg.clearCacheConfirm2: Clear cached files? {usage}. Library entries are kept and can be re-cached.
tg.clearCacheDone2: Removed {removed} cached files ({skipped} external files skipped)
tg.selectGroup: Select a group on the left
tg.feedLoadFailed: Failed to load content. Reselect the channel or try again later
tg.historyEmpty: No media in this channel yet
tg.globalSearchScope: Only locally synced monitored messages are searched
tg.monitorViewHint: Local monitor list; cached content stays readable offline
tg.monitorEmpty: No monitored channels yet. Toggle a switch in a group below.
tg.emptyCached: No cached items yet. Monitored content is indexed automatically for caching.
tg.serviceOffline: TG service is offline. Start the APP or sign in to browse the media library.
tg.selectToPlay: Select an item on the left to play
tg.downloadDirTip: Where cached files are saved. Applies immediately (new caches only).
tg.decodeFail: This format (e.g. .mov/QuickTime) cannot be decoded by the browser, and the compatibility stream is also unavailable. Make sure the OrigHub backend service (orig-tg) is running, or open the original file with your system player outside the app
tg.decodeUnsupported: This video's codec cannot be decoded by the local browser (e.g. HEVC/H.265). Loading has been stopped to avoid wasted traffic; open the original file with the system player
tg.decodeStrained: Decoding is struggling: frames are being dropped. A lower playback speed will be noticeably smoother
tg.setupTip: One-time setup: create an app at my.telegram.org → API development tools, then enter the api_id and api_hash below. The app stores the config and starts the service automatically afterwards.
tg.unavailableHint: orig-tg could not reach Telegram, so sending codes and signing in will fail. Open Settings → Accounts for the reason.
tg.unreachableHint: orig-tg is not running, so the sign-in state cannot be confirmed. Start it from Settings → Accounts and retry.
tg.unboundHint: There is no active Telegram session, so channel content cannot be shown yet. Bind the account to continue.
tg.onboardDisabledHint: Once enabled, you can monitor channels, cache media, and import the results into your library.
tg.onboardScope: Scope: only channels you actively monitor; files already on this machine are untouched.
tg.onboardStartingHint: The service is starting up and usually takes a few seconds. Nothing to do meanwhile.
tg.reasonOfflineDebug: Running in offline debug mode; orig-tg is not connected to Telegram.
tg.retryUnsupported: Retry needs the desktop app: browser mode cannot restart the orig-tg service.
tg.retryFailed: Retry failed. Open Connection diagnostics below for the recent logs.
tg.reasonNetwork: Cannot reach Telegram. Check your network and proxy settings, then retry.
tg.reasonAuth: The Telegram credentials are no longer valid. Please bind the account again.
tg.reasonStalled: Transfer stalled: the connection was established but the byte stream stopped advancing, so this item was aborted to keep the queue moving. Retrying usually helps; if it persists, check proxy stability.
tg.reasonTooSlow: Download too slow: this item exceeded the per-item time cap (30 minutes by default), so it was aborted to keep the queue moving. Retry to resume it; if the source stays slow, raise the per-item download timeout setting.
tg.reasonRestarted: Interrupted by a service restart. This task is resumable: already-downloaded items are kept, and a retry only fetches the ones that are missing.
tg.reasonFlood: Telegram is rate-limiting this account. Please try again later.
tg.reasonConfig: Telegram API credentials are not configured yet. Finish the service setup first.
tg.reasonUnknown: Telegram is temporarily unavailable. Retry later, or open Settings → Accounts for diagnostics.
error.boundaryDesc: The TG panel failed to render. Retry or check the TG service.
media.recacheQueued: Re-queued for caching; bytes will return to the library when done
media.recacheFrom: Re-fetch bytes from {source} (the record stays in the library)
media.recacheUnavailable: {source} service is not connected — re-caching is unavailable
media.episode.cacheDoneNoBytes: Caching finished but bytes are missing
media.fileMissingHint: File missing: no bytes found on disk
media.removeEpisodeImage: Remove image (the record stays in the library)
media.noPhotosInLibrary: No photo items in the library yet — import or cache some first
media.sourceOfflineHint: Source service offline ({sources}): library content stays playable and manageable — only re-caching is unavailable.
media.title: Library
media.exportNoSeries: No series yet: cache TG content or import local files to create one
media.exportSummary: {total} series checked, {ready} ready, {issues} issue(s) to fix
media.exportTargetHint: The export bundle will be written here (must be empty to avoid overwriting existing files)
media.exportNeedFix: Fix the issues above before exporting
media.exportBlockedByReadiness: Export blocked by readiness check; fix the issues above and retry
media.addToSeriesVideoOnly: Series accept videos and photos (photos go to the gallery): deselect audio and other kinds
media.organize.title: Batch organize {n} item(s)
media.organize.varsHint: Variables: {series} {season} {episode} {episodeTitle} {source} {date} {ext}. Zero-pad with a format spec, e.g. {season:02} -> S01. Unknown variables render empty. Directories are created along the template path.
media.organize.targetPlaceholder: Pick a folder for the organized files
media.organize.targetHint: Organized files are hard links (same volume) or copies (cross volume); the library blob is never moved. Delete them freely - playback still uses the blob.
media.organize.conflict: Name taken: an ordinal suffix was added (nothing is overwritten)
media.organize.safeHint: Idempotent - re-running only writes what is missing; nothing in the library is renamed.
media.bulkTagHint: Existing tags on the selected items will be replaced by the checked ones.
media.tag.description: Tags are attached to items or series as #name for cross-cutting search and filtering.
media.tag.pickerEmpty: No tags yet — create one in "Tag Manager" first
media.emptyHint: Content from Telegram caching or imports appears here automatically; auto-ingest of HTTP downloads is being completed (until then, use “Open folder” to reach those files). You can also use “Import folder” to index a local video/photo directory. Files stay where they are — nothing is copied or moved.
media.fileList.name: Name
media.fileList.dblHint: Click to select, double-click to open
media.fileList.noPath: No local path for this item — cannot open its folder
media.fileList.openDirWebUnsupported: Opening the system folder is unavailable in web preview mode — use the desktop app
media.showing: Showing {n} / {total} — use search or filters to narrow down
media.confirmRemoveItemsHint: Removes {n} entries from the library (tags and series links included). Original files on disk are NOT deleted; cached bytes are handled under "Clear cache".
media.confirmDeleteSeriesHint: Deletes the series and its episode list. The media entries themselves stay in the library as unassigned items.
media.seriesGone: This series has been deleted or merged. Returned to the series list.
player.unsupported: This type cannot be previewed in the app
player.noContent: This content has no playable bytes (cache cleared or file missing) and cannot play in the app. Try "Re-cache", or open the original file with your system player
media.confirmRemoveOne: Delete this entry from the library
media.confirmGroupedWarn: {m} of them belong to a series; deleting them may leave that series empty.
tg.bytesConfirm: Reclaim {n} temp files ({size})? Library entries are kept and can be re-cached.
tg.bytesDone: Reclaimed {n} temp files (freed {size}, skipped {skipped} external files)
media.series.mergeHint: Merge another series into this one (the source series is deleted)
media.series.cacheMissingQueued: Queued {enqueued} cache task(s) ({skipped} episode(s) skipped: no cacheable source)
media.series.splitHint: Move wrongly-merged entries into a new series (inverse of merge)
media.series.splitTitleRequired: Please enter a new series title
media.series.splitDone: Moved {moved} episode(s) into a new series
media.series.cacheGapHint: Queue the un-slotted missing items (images excluded)
media.seriesMergeKeepHint: The other selected series will be merged into this one, and the source series are then deleted. The direction is chosen explicitly here, independent of the click order.
media.seriesMergeConfirmBody: The other {n} series will be merged into {target}, the source series will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.
media.seriesMergeTargetSuffix: ({n} eps); the source series is then deleted.
media.seriesMergeEmpty: No other series available to merge
media.seriesMergeOrderHint: Episodes are appended in their original order to the end of each season in the target and renumbered; entries already in the target are not added again. Items with the same file name but different content, and different sources of the same item, are all kept as-is — merging makes no judgement about content.
media.seriesMergeNumberPrefix: Episode numbering: each season of the target continues from
media.seriesMergeNumberSuffix: onward (existing numbers are never overwritten). Each merged episode keeps a "Merged from <source series> · was E<n>" provenance note, and can be renumbered or moved later in the detail view. Tags from both series are merged and deduplicated — nothing is lost, nothing duplicated.
media.seriesMergeConfirmBodySingle: The {n} episodes of {source} will be merged into {target}. The source series will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.
media.series.bulkMergeDisabled: Merging needs at least 2 series selected
media.seriesConfirmBulkHint: The groupings below will be removed. This cannot be undone.
media.seriesConfirmKeepItemsHint: Items and downloaded files are kept; only the grouping is removed.
media.seriesBulkTagHint: Existing tags on the selected series will be replaced by the checked ones.
media.series.bytesMissing.partial: {n} episodes are missing bytes; the operation can't complete
media.series.errTitleEmpty: Series title cannot be empty — an unnamed series becomes an unrecognizable card on the wall
media.episode.editAffectsAll: Title and description come from the content itself; edits affect every place that references it.
media.episode.endHintRow: (set an end when one file holds several episodes; an occupied slot swaps with that episode)
media.episode.endNormalized: End episode {end} is not greater than start episode {start}; saved as a single episode
media.episode.errSlot: Season and episode numbers must be integers ≥ 1
media.episode.errTitleEmpty: Title cannot be empty — an untitled entry becomes an unrecognizable card in the library
media.episode.errEnd: End episode must be an integer ≥ 1 (blank = single)
media.episode.gotoItem: View this content in the library
media.episode.moveUp: Move up one (swap with previous episode)
media.episode.moveDown: Move down one (swap with next episode)
media.episode.firstInSeason: Already the first episode of this season
media.episode.lastInSeason: Already the last episode of this season
media.episode.removeFromSeries: Remove from series (the record stays in the library)
media.episode.noPlayable: No playable video in this series
media.episode.empty: Nothing here yet — pick items under “All content” and use “Add to series”
media.episode.recacheNoRoute: The source of this episode ({source}) has no address to re-fetch from
media.episode.recacheQueued: Re-queued for caching; this episode will play again once it completes
media.recacheNoRoute: The source of this item ({source}) has no address to re-fetch from
media.item.title: Title
media.item.descHint: (everything after the original message title — the same field as the series description)
media.item.descPlaceholder: Leave empty to clear the description
media.item.cacheConfirm: Clear the cached file? The record is kept and can be cached again.
